provenance.command: stress-ng --judy W --judy-size 4194304 --judy-ops 3W --seed 12345 -t T --metrics; T = 300 at W 1 and 4, 900 at W 8

estimators.columns: counts summed over a process tree's workers, per repeat
estimators.ratio: none in this artifact: every figure is an exact count; the README's ratios are quotients of two of these counts
estimators.raw: every cell carries both repeats in full; nothing is sampled, so there are no rounds and no interval

provenance.instrument_2: none: strace sees no system call under the emulation
provenance.statistics: exact counts summed over a process tree's workers; no interval

provenance.void: A first pass of this census, without load snapshots, is not the artifact. In it, N's W = 8 cell at -t 300 stopped short (17 of 24 bogo ops on amd64; 16 and 18 under strace on arm64) and was re-run at -t 900. This artifact is a second, complete pass of every cell under the load-snapshot driver, W = 1 and 4 at -t 300, W = 8 at -t 900.
